bio:
Hongdam is a highly skilled illustrative tattoo artist based in Milan, Italy with an impressive following of roughly 370,000 on Instagram. Known not only for his particular style and artistry, but also for his polite and professional demeanor. Maintaining a standard of cleanliness in his studio, Hongdam offers a distinct and pleasant tattooing experience to his clientele.
